findings.title: Require an immutable commit for the configuration-hub snapshot
findings.body: The new gate only verifies that `--revision` is present and then uses the supplied revision string directly for `git show` and all generated source URLs. A movable ref such as `master` or `HEAD` passes the byte check at generation time, but later moves, causing the published hub to point at sources different from the reviewed inventory it claims to snapshot. Resolve and require a commit object ID, then use that resolved ID for both verification and links.

overall_explanation: The configuration-hub publication path does not actually pin its claimed reviewed source snapshot to an immutable revision.
